summary: Frontend-only regression covering the 6 new/updated features on NOI DI 2D. 5/6 fully pass. Admin login+dashboard 'Pillola del giorno' OK; News create-with-attachment + delete OK (attachment link rendered with data-testid news-attachment-*); Chat censorship of Italian bad word 'cazzo' → '*****' OK, single hover delete + multi-select 'Elimina (n)' bulk delete OK; Admin temp 24h ban blocks member login with toast 'Sei sospeso fino al ...' (403), unban restores successful login; OFFLINE flow: service worker registers and controls the page, [data-testid=offline-banner] appears when going offline, [data-testid=chat-input] and send button become disabled, previously cached chat messages remain rendered read-only, going back online removes the banner. ONE INTEGRATION BUG in Events: per-group counter does not increment client-side after signup (stays 0/2) although backend registers the signup (visible via 'Vedi iscritti' modal).

integration_issues.issue: After POST /api/events/{id}/signup the client updates only signed_up/signup_count/my_option — it does NOT update option_counts. Result: the per-option button label stays at e.g. '0/2' even after the current user joins Squadra A. Highlighting (variant + check icon) works because my_option is set, but the visible per-group count is stale until a full page refresh (which re-fetches /api/events). Backend is correct: 'Vedi iscritti' modal shows the 1 signup row immediately.

issues: Radix DialogContent still lacks aria-describedby → 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' console warning (a11y, non-blocking).

action_items: Events.js signup(): after receiving the response, also merge option_counts. Either (a) return option_counts from POST /api/events/{id}/signup and set it in state, or (b) simply call load() again to re-fetch all events. Recommended: include option_counts in the signup response and merge it: setEvents((ev) => ev.map((e) => e.id === id ? { ...e, ...data } : e)).
OPTIONAL: add DialogDescription to the Ban dialog in Admin.js to silence the Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Events.js signup response merge is incomplete — option_counts must be part of the merged state (or trigger a refresh). This is the only real functional gap found in this iteration.

SW offline fallback: when the user navigates to a fresh route (e.g. /news) while already offline and that route was never navigated to before, the SW falls back to the cached app-shell ('/'). Because BrowserRouter reads window.location, this means the user lands on Dashboard rather than /news. Not a bug per se (SPA shell fallback pattern), but consider deep-link support by caching /news, /events, /chat as shell aliases if this becomes a UX concern.

Chat page polls /api/chat/messages every 3s via setInterval; while offline these polls all fail with ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED and pollute the console — consider pausing polling when useOnline() is false.

News attachment link embeds the raw token in the URL as ?auth=<token> (news-attachment-*). Works, but exposes the JWT in browser history / referrer headers on any click. Consider using Authorization header via a fetch-and-blob download instead.
Layout cache-warming useEffect fires on every route change; harmless but redundant — could gate on a ref to run once per session.

rca of the issue: Events option counter stuck at 0/2 → In /app/frontend/src/pages/Events.js signup() the state merge is: setEvents((ev) => ev.map((e) => e.id === id ? { ...e, signed_up: data.signed_up, signup_count: data.signup_count, my_option: data.my_option } : e)) — this deliberately omits option_counts. So the per-group '{cnt}/{cap}' rendered from e.option_counts?.[opt] never advances until the user leaves and returns to /events (which triggers load() → GET /api/events with fresh option_counts). Fix: either include option_counts in POST /api/events/{id}/signup response and merge it (best UX, no extra roundtrip), or simply call load() after signup. The backend already tracks counts correctly (verified: 'Vedi iscritti' modal returned 1 signup row immediately after clicking Squadra A).
